en.name: Trinitas Magistus
en.effect:
2+ Spellcaster monsters
If this card is Special Summoned from the Extra Deck: You can equip 1 "Magistus" or Spellcaster monster from your Extra Deck to this card as an Equip Spell. You can discard 1 card; return all Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, and Link Monsters from your opponent's field and GY to the Extra Deck. During your opponent's Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can add 1 "Magistus" card from your GY or banishment to your hand. You can only use 1 "Trinitas Magistus" effect per turn, and only once that turn.
